newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate cuts gains at close.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate cuts gains at close.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates reined in earlier gains to close up 20 basis points at 22 percent on Friday as month-end liquidity pressures ebbed in late trade, dealers said.
Overnight Cetes rates had opened up 25 basis points at a session high of 22.05.
"Rates were very stable. We had some spikes during the session, but rates soon settled down," a dealer said.
Overnight rates on bank paper closed down 50 basis points at 23 percent.
